uncited: Ray Sampling and Generation constructs the geometric primitives (origins $\mathbf{o}$ and directions $\mathbf{d}$) required for volume rendering, mapping 2D pixel coordinates to 3D world-space rays .
It solves the initialization problem for volumetric integration by providing structured sampling points along the viewing frustum .

It differs from its siblings by focusing on the geometric transformation from pixel indices to ray vectors, whereas methods like [Near-Far Linear Ray Generation](6841-near-far-linear-ray-generation.md) focus on depth discretization along those rays, and [Refined Ray Generation via PDF Sampling](6837-refined-ray-generation-via-pdf-sampling.md) focuses on adaptive depth sampling based on prior weights .
The specific application to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) popularized the grid-based sampling of rays from intrinsic/extrinsic matrices for training .
The construction of `RaySamples` with frustum geometry is a later development in differentiable volumetric rendering to enable accurate density and color integration .
